title: reconcile RAID I-5 verification against cited sources + close A-10
body:
I-5: the 4 source_mappings flagged verified=true with stale "honest
verified=false" notes (Meta EMQ, SendGrid event webhook, Meta Lead Ads/
Messenger, Google gclid) are external vendor-API fields. The "false" note was
an artifact of the deterministic grep running against DAS internal DDL, which
by definition never contains external vendor-API fields. Checked each against
its cited vendor research page and confirmed the field is documented there:
wiki:meta (Dataset-Quality EMQ; Lead Ads/Messenger), wiki:sendgrid (event
webhook delivered/open/click/bounce/unsubscribe), wiki:google-ads (GCLID click
attribution via auto-tagging). Rewrote the 4 notes to cite the wiki page as the
evidence -- verified=true means present in the cited vendor page, not
per-consumer-ingested by DAS today (access stays api-unused/granted). No
per-person verification is asserted. Aligned record.json status + changelog and
added a post-v1.0 reconciliation note to REVIEW.md.

A-10: resolved tenant-scale assumption. The CDP supports both the ~1,700 pilot
cohort and the full ~9,200+ footprint without redesign; deliverable cost models
re-parameterize by tenant count. Not a blocker (decision: Leo Mata).

RAID register bumped v10 -> v11; both items moved open -> resolved.

body: feat: wire chat agent to the compiled brain + reframe Option B as Phase 2

title: give the chat agent a search_brain tool
body:
The portal compiles a 2,600-node project brain (app/brain.json) but the
chat agent only queried the 1,300-node discovery KG — the richer asset was
built, validated, and never read at query time. Add a search_brain tool
(search + neighbor traversal over brain.json) mirroring search_graph for
the {id,kind,label,source}/{src,dst,type} envelope: returns matching
records with kind, status, owner, source file, and typed relationships
rendered with neighbor labels. Degrades to empty on a malformed brain.json
like loadGraph. System prompt differentiates it from search_graph.

title: reframe Option B as the Phase 2 evolution
body:
Option B (ML-blended scoring) read as a considered-and-rejected Phase 1
alternative. It is really the Phase 2 destination — the same model-assisted
matching, deferred until curation under Option A produces the labeled
training data an ML matcher needs. Retitle, status draft -> phase-2 (new
blue badge), and rewrite summary/intent/status to say so. Recommendation
(Option A locked for Phase 1) unchanged; historical changelog preserved.

title: add golden record worked examples
body:
All proposed CDP identity and golden record strategies exercised
across three scenarios and four appendices:

- Example 1: clean single-source record — deterministic auto-merge,
  bitemporal provenance, consent ledger
- Example 2: complex cross-source — curation queue, orphan upgrade,
  multi-tenant RLS, CCID backfill, survivorship edge cases
- Example 3: heuristic path, below-floor no-link, association
  provenance with per-field score breakdown
- Appendix A: household detection
- Appendix B: merge reversal / split with bitemporal reattachment
- Appendix C: identity event sourcing and as-of replay
- Appendix D: crypto-shred / erasure with erasure-no-resurrect

Covers every strategy in Option A (locked 2026-06-17), the
survivorship matrix from PR #131, and the consent-ledger mechanism
decided 2026-06-18. Coverage map at bottom of doc cross-references
each strategy to the scenario exercising it.
